research_question: What were the extreme streamflow conditions (minimum and maximum mean daily discharge) at the Truckee River near Mogul, NV during the 2002-2005 period?

phase_1.user_prompt: I am researching the hydrologic context of surface-water quality sampling conducted on the Truckee River upstream of Reno, Nevada between 2002 and 2005. I want to retrieve daily streamflow records from the USGS streamgage located near Mogul, NV. How can I identify this site and what parameters do I need to query for daily mean discharge over this four-year calendar period?

phase_2.user_prompt: Using the identified site number for the Truckee River near Mogul, retrieve the complete daily mean streamflow record over the 4 calendar years beginning in 2002.

phase_3.user_prompt: To understand the low-flow conditions during the study period, process the daily streamflow time series and identify the absolute minimum mean daily flow recorded between 2002 and 2005 at the Mogul gage.

phase_4.user_prompt: High winter-spring flows are also an important factor for contaminant transport. Analyze the same dataset to find the peak high-flow condition. What was the maximum mean daily flow recorded at the Mogul site during the 2002-2005 study period?
